en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Thus, the ten days that Monokuma
gave us passed...

Well, ten days have passed.
And it looks like...
Shuichi wasn't able to seal the deal...
with anyone!
Wh-What happens now?
I dunno.

Celebs who've fallen from the public eye...
Artists whose projects get canceled...

They knew the risks of pursuing their dreams
and failed anyway.

So they should take responsibility for that
failure, right?

You're on your own cuz you failed on your own.
So I dunno what's gonna happen to you.

B-But, it's not my fault, I didn't
choose to come here...

Blurgh! Hurk! Your semantic argument
makes me wanna hurl!

You should've spent more time working on
your love game, instead.

At any rate, I dunno what's gonna happen
to you from this point.

Try to escape or give up and kill yourself...
Do whatever you want!
Well then, see ya later!

<CLT=cltMIND>He said in his usual sneering cadence,
then disappeared from view.

<CLT=cltMIND>...This academy is now under Monokuma's
control.
<CLT=cltMIND>But, that's why...
<CLT=cltMIND>I can't escape the despair.

<CLT=cltMIND>I know I cannot possibly escape
by myself...
<CLT=cltMIND>If Monokuma is gone, then...
<CLT=cltMIND>My consciousness faded quickly...

<CLT=cltMIND>This is how my days at the
academy ended...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>No, it won't end...
<CLT=cltMIND>It won't end until I die.

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>ending<CLT=cltMIND> that will never end.
I await with open arms.
